motionRule: Sustain meaningful action through the beat: interact, transform, transition, hand off. A static hold with only zoom in/out is insufficient.
chatUiRule: Verify the current Claude, ChatGPT or Codex UI online for every new build. Use a real capture; record URL/date/variant. A bundled capture is a dated example, not proof of current UI.
interactionRule: Use touch/gesture cues for phones. Never show a mouse cursor on a phone. Desktop pointer actions must cause the displayed change.
selectionRule: Use references/template-selection.md to match script meaning and section to an approved template without opening previews or source. Only explicitly approved templates may be reused; prioritize relevant, engaging short-form b-roll. Current product UI verification and final-render QA remain separate requirements. Auditions are closed.
reelTemplatesNote: 10 full-frame scenes ported from reference reels Ddjfv-WP9yo and DdeVVlpT9zW. Text-free by design (no captions, stat text or tool names). Import from ./devices. Selection: references/template-selection.md "Reel templates". All default to 5 s (len=150) and ship approved presets (REEL_TEMPLATE_PRESETS); swap logos + facts only.
